observations.body: Foreigner, bought servant, hired worker, resident stranger, native-born person, and congregation are distinguished.
observations.label: Boundaries

observations.body: One house, meat kept inside, circumcision, and unbroken bones give the ordinance physical boundaries.
observations.label: House and body

observations.body: Israel does as commanded, and the LORD’s act of bringing them out closes the unit.
observations.label: Closing action

payload.posture: Stay with this witness’s people, objects, speech, sequence, and stated connections before moving to another account or later use.
payload.tension: The ordinance combines exclusion, a path of entry, and one law without erasing its bodily and household conditions.
payload.title: One-house boundaries and one law govern participation
